Case D: a nested scroller, to see which element a wheel actually reaches

childNodes.textContent: Records every input event the page actually receives, so humanized and non-humanized runs can be compared on evidence rather than impression.
cursor trail — green = first sample, red = latest

Tall filler so the WINDOW itself can scroll a full viewport, which is what
     "scroll down one screen" means. Without it the page fits and a page-level
     scroll is a no-op.
